DomainPage.dnsTargetHint: DNS records auto-created when publishing a public URL point here: use A with the gateway public IP, or CNAME with the gateway hostname. A wrong value breaks every URL published afterwards.

GatewayPage.pageSubtitle: Manage HAProxy, Traefik, and WireGuard VPN configuration and runtime status
GatewayPage.publicKeyHint: Add this public key to the Gateway VM's ~/.ssh/authorized_keys so the platform can manage services over SSH.
GatewayPage.regenerateKeypairMessage: The old keypair will become invalid immediately after regenerating, and the platform will be unable to connect to the Gateway VM over SSH until the new public key is added to ~/.ssh/authorized_keys. Continue?
GatewayPage.reloadConfigMessage: There are unsaved changes. Reloading will discard them. Continue?
GatewayPage.resetHostKeyHint: Use this when the connection is refused after reinstalling the Gateway VM changed its host key
GatewayPage.resetHostKeyMessage: This clears the SSH host key the platform has recorded for the Gateway VM; it will be recorded again on the next connection. Only use this after reinstalling or replacing the Gateway VM machine — if the host key mismatch was not caused by a change you expected, it may indicate a man-in-the-middle attack, so investigate first. Continue resetting?
GatewayPage.switchTabMessage: There are unsaved config file changes. Switching tabs will discard them. Continue?
GatewayPage.toastConfigReadFailed: Failed to read {{service}} config file, please reload and try again
GatewayPage.toastConfigWritten: Config file written; remember to reload / restart the service to apply it
GatewayPage.toastKeypairGenerated: New SSH keypair generated; please add the public key to the Gateway VM
GatewayPage.wireGuardDescription: Review VPN sessions, live peers, and the service health on the Gateway.
GatewayPage.wireGuardExpiredSessions: {{count}} expired authorized session(s) are waiting for cleanup.
GatewayPage.wireGuardLoadFailed: Unable to load the WireGuard VPN overview
GatewayPage.wireGuardSecurityHint: This page only shows aggregate status. Gateway private keys and peer public keys are never returned to the browser.
GovernanceTab.alertCooldownMinutesHint: The same target/metric pair won't re-alert within the cooldown window
GovernanceTab.alertEmailEnabledHint: Send an email to administrators when an alert is created
GovernanceTab.alertsDesc: Create an alert event and notify administrators (in-app + email) when a threshold is exceeded.
GovernanceTab.cloneConcurrencyDesc: Maximum number of concurrent VM/LXC clone operations (cloning is disk I/O-intensive on PVE; too high a value can overwhelm storage). Changes take effect on the next scheduling cycle.
GovernanceTab.courseLabDesc: Lab machines students launch from a course room: reclaimed automatically on expiry, with a cap on how many each student can run at once. Personal resource quotas still apply.
GovernanceTab.courseMaxActivePerUserHint: Once the limit is reached, an existing environment must be terminated before launching another
GovernanceTab.courseTtlHoursHint: How long after launch the environment expires; reclamation then follows the TTL lifecycle
GovernanceTab.expiryGraceDeleteDaysHint: How many days after the expiry shutdown before the resource is queued for deletion
GovernanceTab.expiryWarnDaysHint: The background job notifies N days before expiry; how early the student UI shows its warning banner is the Expiry Warning setting on the Scheduling page.
GovernanceTab.idleDesc: Resources with CPU consistently below the threshold are first notified to their owner, then automatically shut down (not deleted) once the grace period ends.
GovernanceTab.idleDetectionEnabledHint: Detect running resources with consistently low CPU usage
GovernanceTab.idleGraceHoursHint: Automatically shut down once the resource has stayed idle for this many hours since detection; must be longer than the idle notification delay
GovernanceTab.idleNotifyAfterHoursHint: Notify the owner only after the resource has stayed idle for this many hours since detection; must be shorter than the shutdown grace period
GovernanceTab.idleWindowHoursHint: A resource counts as idle only after running continuously for this many hours with average CPU below the threshold; a reboot restarts the count
GovernanceTab.miningAutoSuspendHint: When disabled, only an event and notification are created; suspension must be performed manually by an administrator
GovernanceTab.miningDesc: Resources with sustained high CPU load are automatically snapshotted, suspended, and reported; account suspension requires manual confirmation by an administrator under "Resource Monitoring → Mining Incidents".
GovernanceTab.miningDetectionEnabledHint: Periodically scan the CPU profile of running resources
GovernanceTab.miningWindowHoursHint: Flagged only once average CPU stays above the threshold for this many hours
GovernanceTab.snapshotCleanupEnabledHint: Unprotected snapshots older than the retention period will be scheduled for deletion
GovernanceTab.snapshotDesc: Periodically clean up expired student snapshots (the skylab-init initial snapshot is never cleaned up), and limit the number of student snapshots per VM.
GovernanceTab.studentSnapshotMaxCountHin: Excludes skylab-init; older snapshots must be deleted before creating more once the limit is reached
GovernanceTab.ttlDesc: Progressive reclamation after a resource expires: notify before expiry → shut down at expiry → queue for deletion once the grace period ends.
GovernanceTab.ttlEnabledHint: Automatically notify, shut down, and queue for deletion based on resource expiry date
GovernanceTab.workloadAdvisorDesc: Offer an "auto-detect" mode when requesting resources, where a rule engine recommends VM or LXC based on the workload.
GovernanceTab.workloadAdvisorEnabledHint: When disabled, the request form only allows manually selecting the resource type
IpManagementPage.deleteSubnetMessage: Are you sure you want to delete the subnet configuration? This will disable VM / LXC creation site-wide, and requires that no VM / LXC still occupies an IP before it can be deleted.
IpManagementPage.pageSubtitle: Manage subnet configuration and all IP address allocations
IpManagementPage.searchPlaceholder: Search by IP, VMID, or description
JobsPage.pageSubtitle: Track long-running tasks such as deployments, requests, and resource provisioning
LdapTab.adminGroupDnHint: Users belonging to this group are created with the admin role
LdapTab.autoCreateUsersHint: When disabled, only existing local accounts can sign in via LDAP
LdapTab.enableLdapLoginHint: It's recommended to verify the settings with "Test Connection" before enabling
LdapTab.loginSectionDesc: Once enabled, a "Campus Account" tab appears on the login page, authenticating against your institution's directory account.
LdapTab.roleMappingSectionDesc: Accounts are auto-created on first login (default role: student), and roles are mapped based on group DN.
LdapTab.serviceAccountSectionDesc: Bind with a service account to search for users, then authenticate with the user's password.
LdapTab.teacherGroupDnHint: Users belonging to this group are created with the teacher role
LdapTab.useStartTlsHint: Upgrade an ldap:// connection to an encrypted one (not needed for ldaps://)
LdapTab.userFilterTemplateHint: {username} will be substituted with the account entered at login
MiningIncidentsPanel.banConfirmMessage: The account owning VMID {{vmid}} will be suspended (unable to sign in); the VM will remain suspended to preserve evidence. An administrator can restore this in User Management.
MiningIncidentsPanel.desc: Resources suspected of mining due to sustained high CPU load (already auto-documented and suspended, pending administrator review)
MiningIncidentsPanel.dismissMessage: VMID {{vmid}} will be marked as a false positive and an attempt will be made to resume it.
MiningIncidentsPanel.emptyNone: No mining incidents at the moment
MiningIncidentsPanel.exemptLabel: Also add this resource to the exemption list (won't be detected again)
MiningIncidentsPanel.title: Mining Incidents
MiningIncidentsPanel.toastDismissedAndRe: Incident dismissed and VM resume attempted
MonitoringPage.activeAlertsDesc: Resource usage alerts exceeding thresholds (updated every 30 seconds)
MonitoringPage.panelTabsAria: Switch between alerts and mining incidents
MonitoringPage.emptyNoAlerts: No active alerts at the moment
MonitoringPage.errorFetchOverview: Unable to fetch monitoring data; please check the Proxmox connection status.
MonitoringPage.nodeUsageDesc: Shows nodes needing attention and the busiest by default; click a row to expand its usage trend chart
MonitoringPage.noTrendData: No trend data for this node yet
MonitoringPage.pageSubtitle: Cluster resource usage, node trends, and threshold alerts
QuotasTab.createHint: Fields are pre-filled with the current global defaults — just adjust them into this user's own limits.
QuotasTab.deleteQuotaMessage: Are you sure you want to delete the quota for "{{target}}"? The global default will apply after deletion.
QuotasTab.globalQuotaDesc: Changes only affect future creation and expansion — existing resources are not retroactively affected.
QuotasTab.overridesDesc: Set dedicated limits for specific users.
SettingsPage.clusterResourceSettingsDesc: Pool, storage, and subnet are settings specific to each cluster; VMs / LXCs created on this connection will use the values configured here.
SettingsPage.deleteConnectionMessage: Are you sure you want to delete the connection "{{name}}"? Its node and storage records will be removed as well.
SettingsPage.disableNodeHint: Once disabled, no new VMs are placed here; existing VMs are unaffected
SettingsPage.governanceSubtitle: Controls what happens after machines are provisioned: alerts, TTL reclamation, idle and mining detection, snapshots, and clone concurrency.
SettingsPage.ldapSubtitle: Connection, service account, and role mapping for LDAP / Active Directory sign-in.
SettingsPage.nodeHostHint: Address the platform uses to call this node's PVE API; a wrong value breaks sync and power actions.
SettingsPage.nodePriorityHint: Lower wins; only breaks ties when placement scores are close (default 5).
SettingsPage.nodesHint: Host / Port is the address the platform uses to call this node's PVE API. Priority only breaks ties when placement scores are close - lower wins (default 5) - and takes effect on the next placement.
SettingsPage.storageHint: Storage selection order: fastest speed tier first (NVMe > SSD > HDD), then the least crowded; user priority only breaks ties - lower wins (default 5). The speed tier is not auto-detected - set it to match the actual hardware.
SettingsPage.noConnectionsYet: No connections created yet. Click "Add Connection" to complete your first setup (it will automatically become the default connection).
SettingsPage.nodeMetricsHintPrefix: For real-time node usage, trend charts, and alerts, go to
SettingsPage.nodesSubtitle: Enablement, address, and placement priority of each PVE node.
SettingsPage.notAcceptingNewVms: Not accepting new VMs (existing VMs unaffected)
SettingsPage.pveConnectionsSubtitle: Manage Proxmox VE connection endpoints and each cluster's own pool, storage, and subnet settings.
SettingsPage.quotasSubtitle: Controls how much a user can take at request time - over-limit requests are rejected. Per-user overrides take precedence over the global defaults.
SettingsPage.expiryWarningHoursHint: Only controls how many hours ahead the student UI shows the expiring-soon banner; the actual notify, stop, and delete after expiry are handled by the TTL lifecycle on the Governance page.
SettingsPage.schedulerSubtitle: Controls where machines land and when they boot: placement, overcommit, and scheduled-boot parameters shared across clusters.
SettingsPage.placementOvercommitDesc: Takes effect immediately: shapes the next VM placement and overcommit calculation.
SettingsPage.resourceThresholdsDesc: Takes effect immediately: shapes node scoring and penalties for the next placement decision.
SettingsPage.scheduledBootDesc: Takes effect on the next scheduling cycle: pacing and grace period for class batch boots.
SettingsPage.practiceExpiryDesc: User-experience settings: practice auto-stop duration and student-facing warning timing - unrelated to the placement algorithm.
SettingsPage.storageSubtitle: Speed tier, user priority, and enablement of each storage; placement picks disks based on these.
SettingsPage.toastLoadConnectionsFailed: Failed to load PVE connection list
SubnetConfigForm.cardDesc: Once the subnet is configured, the system will automatically assign a static IP when creating a VM / LXC.
SubnetConfigForm.cidrLockedHint: This range is already in use by VMs / LXCs; delete those machines first before changing the CIDR.
SubnetConfigForm.extraBlockedSubnetsHint: Saving will create or update outbound DROP rules on all VMs / LXCs, and remove any rules that have been taken out. This restricts destinations for connections initiated by VMs; it is not a target blocklist for website or port publishing.
SubnetConfigForm.gatewayVmIpHint: Must differ from the Gateway IP.
DomainPage.managedBySystemHint: Created by this system's published URL feature (VM {{vmid}})
DomainPage.externalRecordHint: Not created by this system (added manually on Cloudflare or elsewhere)
